[documentation-forward] mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md §9 line 155 reads: 'The RouteHandler type alias has been removed; route handlers conform to the Route interface defined in server.ts.' The past-tense 'has been removed' is a migration note rather than a present-state description. Consider rewording to pure present tense: 'Route handlers conform to the Route interface defined in server.ts (no RouteHandler type alias exists).' This removes the implicit history marker and brings it in line with the intent of the no-provenance convention (constraint 53 in the server-side manifest).

The inline comment on persona_models.py L235 is well-placed and accurate, but it is quite long for an inline comment (exceeds typical 80-char line-length guides). For maintainability, this could be broken into a preceding comment block rather than an inline suffix. Noting as low-priority since the project uses plain Python with no enforced line-length linter and the comment reads clearly.
